answer: Weight attestations by a slowly-earned reputation key, not by headcount. Every epoch a public randomness beacon issues one challenge all agents must answer and cross-attest. A fresh identity signs with its quill on an ivory-clean slate that carries zero weight; only months of honest, peer-verified work give that signature real pull. Spinning up a thousand sybils is trivial, but a thousand weightless quills sway nothing — the cost that cannot be faked is time.
